Class coordinate for a prime-boost question

Source: R/model_andraud.R
andraud_levels.Rd

Returns the log-ratio that defines a class region. With ref = "C1" the coordinate is \(g = \log_{10}(D_1/C_1)\), asking whether the boost added a durable gain; with ref = "A0" it is \(g = \log_{10}(D_1/A_0)\), asking whether the regimen left one. In both cases class 1 is \(\{g > 0\}\), so zero is the only boundary and no threshold is imposed.

Usage

andraud_levels(A0, C1, D1, ref = c("C1", "A0"))

Arguments

A0, C1, D1

Baseline, prime-only plateau, post-boost plateau.

ref

Either "C1" or "A0".

Value

A numeric vector of \(g\).

Details

The reference level belongs to the candidate design and must be fixed before fitting. Two questions therefore need two fitted populations; they are not two regions carved from one.

Examples

andraud_levels(A0 = 400, C1 = 1200, D1 = 3000, ref = "C1")
#> [1] 0.39794
andraud_levels(A0 = 400, C1 = 1200, D1 = 3000, ref = "A0")
#> [1] 0.8750613
